title: Straw braid
summary: Plait seven strips of golden wheat straw into a flat braid, taking each outer strip over three others in turn, the way the straw braiders of Shandong make braid for hats.
howToPlay: Seven strips of straw hang below the braid.
The pair that crosses next is outlined: tap the strip that goes over.
Keep plaiting until the braid is finished, then press Check.
rules: The outer strip goes over three strips, first from the right, then from the left.
Three stars for 88 or more, two stars for 65 and one star for 40.
Doing nothing scores nothing. Watch and learn plays a whole round for you.
heritageNote: Straw braid has been made on the Shandong peninsula of China for centuries. Wheat straw is split, soaked and plaited into long flat braids that are then sewn round and round into hats and mats.
